title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2611.18078v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. translated_title: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体式重建
translated_abstract: 直接的图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，阻碍了持续的3D力学平衡、生成过程中的干预以及反事实的力控制。相反，从未标定的照片进行单次程序化3D重建会使单目深度和支撑间隙约束不足，导致重建的场景相互穿透或在重力作用下坍塌。我们提出了TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，它从单张照片重建出可执行的、多模式的物理世界，以驱动有状态的3D交互和基于轨迹的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环中合成可分离的视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评估与零力重力平衡预检相结合。经验证的世界编译为一个统一的求解器，耦合刚体、关（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TelePhysica提出了一个闭环框架，通过视觉-语言编码智能体和两阶段验证循环，从单张照片重建可执行的多模式物理世界，克服了扩散模型缺乏持久3D力学平衡与单次程序化重建场景易坍塌的问题，实现有状态的3D交互和基于轨迹的视频合成。
en_tdlr: TelePhysica introduces a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph via a vision-language coding agent with two-stage verification, enabling stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis while overcoming the lack of persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium in diffusion models and the collapse issues in single-pass programmatic reconstruction.
